name_reason: Compliant: data_fd2_ prefix (game global) + domain 'animation' + descriptor 'summon_variant_c_radial_5slot_offsets'. The '5slot' is a real domain dimension (5 radial-ring slots, matches REP MOVSD ECX=5 at 0x26E62), not an address residue. 'offsets' reflects the int32[5] array-of-offsets data type. No hex address residue. The sibling byte-width companion at 0x5250C is named ..._byte_offsets, so this plain ..._offsets correctly denotes the int32 variant of the pair.
purpose: Summon-spell variant-C 5-slot radial animation per-slot x-offset table {10,8,3,0,0}; a slot offset is added as a signed x-coord addend in the state-4/5 sprite blit.
logic_summary: Sole reader fd2_tick_summon_anim_variant_c_5slot_radial (@ 0x26E39) copies the whole table into a stack scratch via REP MOVSD ECX=5 (0x26E62, 5 dwords=20 bytes; 4-byte stride confirms int32, count 5). For the enemy team (runtime_char[caster].bTeam==0) the first 3 entries of the local copy are negated in place (0x26EA1 MOV/0x26EA4 NEG/0x26EA6 store back), proving signed int32. In state 4/5 the local table is indexed by a per-slot scratch sprite-id (ESI=angle_accumulator) and added into the blit x-coordinate (0x27187 ADD EDX,[ESP+ESI*4+8]). The byte-width companion table of the same logical values lives at 0x5250C (data_fd2_animation_summon_variant_c_radial_5slot_byte_offsets, uint8[5]) and starts the next labeled symbol, fixing this table's extent at exactly 20 bytes. The global itself is never written (only the stack copy is mutated).
element_semantics: Per-slot signed x-offset (pixels) for slot i in {0..4} of the variant-C radial summon ring; added to the slot's computed x-coordinate in the state-4/5 blit. Enemy-team blits use the negated first three entries (mirrored horizontally). Values {10, 8, 3, 0, 0}.
notes: Existing src comment (anitab.c lines 328-354) is precise and verified byte-for-byte against the disassembly (REP MOVSD ECX=5 at 0x26E62, NEG of first 3 at 0x26EA4, signed addend at 0x27187 ADD EDX,[ESP+ESI*4+8], values {10,8,3,0,0}); kept verbatim. Ghidra data plate at 0x524F8 was empty (null) -> created a concise plate from the src conclusion (PLATE_COMMENT via run_script_inline). Read-only: only 2 xrefs (0x26E5D DATA base-addr of MOV ESI, 0x26E62 READ from REP MOVSD); no writers -> const confirmed.
